 Oral Order

3 18-07-2023 The present writ petition has been filed seeking the following reliefs:-
"1.i) For issuance of appropriate writ/writs, order/orders, direction/directions for quashing the notice issued in Encroachment Case No. 70/2021-22 against nine named and others with respect to land of different plot including the plot of petitioner i.e., Plot no. 2598 whereby and whereunder petitioner and others were directed to remove the encroachment made on plot no. 2598 as said land is acquired land Patna High Court CWJC No.9801 of 2022(3) dt.18-07-2023 by the Bihar State Housing Board (herein after referred as 'Board').
Rajiv Ranjan Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68075618/
1 (ii) For issuance of appropriate writ/writs, order/orders, direction/directions commanding the respondent authorities that either declare the 33 Khatta from west side of plot no. 2598 out of total area of 22 Bighas which is recorded in the name of Late Jagdeo Narayan Singh and late Chandeshwar Narayan Singh in Khatiyan who happened to be the great grandfather of petitioner and father-in-law of the Jamabandi raiyat and 33 Khattas allotted in the share of petitioner and his brother Priya Ranjan Singh or since compensation has not been paid to the petitioner till date thus respondent Board/State authority may be directed to pay the appropriate and suitable amount of compensation to him against acquisition in the prevailing rate.

entities.text: Rajiv Ranjan Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
(iii) For issuance of appropriate writ/writs, order/orders, direction/directions the respondent authorities not to disturb the peaceful possession of petitioner till decision whether allotted share of petitioner i.e. 33 Khattas is going to be acquired or said land is free from any encumbrance.
(iv) For issuance of appropriate writ/writs, order/orders, direction/directions commanding the respondent authorities to pay appropriate compensation amount for demolition of boundary wall of petitioner on the land in question including 5 to 6 Khattas of land of plot no. 2598 from west side which has not been subject matter of any acquisition.

Patna High Court CWJC No.9801 of 2022(3) dt.18-07-2023 (v) For issuance of appropriate writ/writs, order/orders, direction/directions commanding the respondent authorities not to take any coercive steps and dispossess the petitioner from his peaceful possession on plot no. 2598.

(vi) For issuance of appropriate writ/writs, order/orders, direction/directions commanding the respondent authorities to cancel the land acquisition process by invoking the provision of section 24 of the Right to fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as neither any compensation has been paid to the petitioner nor any final decision has been taken for the termination of fair compensation to petitioner in pursuance of his application number- Digha-B- 101/2014 dated 31.12.2014 and petitioner was directed to submit relevant paper in support of his claim."

sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the parties have pointed out that the lis involved in the present case has already stood adjudicated by a Coordinate Bench of this Court by a judgment dated 25.05.2023,
passed in C.W.J.C No. 9422 of 2022 (Satyendra Rai vs. The State of Bihar & Ors.) and other analogous cases, consequently, the present case is squarely covered by the said judgment dated 25.05.2003, hence the present writ petition be also disposed off in similar terms.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Patna High Court CWJC No.9801 of 2022(3) dt.18-07-2023

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it fit and proper to dispose off the present writ petition in terms of the aforesaid judgment dated 25.05.2023, passed by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court in the case of Satyendra Rai (supra).
